response.justification: Bogdan Szabo is an accomplished full-stack engineer with strong software craftsmanship practices and some fintech exposure. However, he fundamentally fails to meet the mandatory technical requirements for this capital markets role. He has approximately 6 months of C++ experience (versus required 5–10 years), minimal SQL expertise with no documented SQL Server or Oracle background, no demonstrated Windows platform development, and no capital markets or fixed-income domain knowledge. His RIDE Capital experience, while fintech-adjacent, was web-stack-based (Node.js, TypeScript, GraphQL) rather than the specialized systems environment this role requires.
strengths: Demonstrates strong software engineering fundamentals (TDD, CI/CD, testing practices) that support system reliability
Has fintech exposure from RIDE Capital role contributing to investment platform development in Germany
Excellent communication and mentoring abilities evidenced by workshops, courses, and open-source leadership
concerns: Critically lacks C++ expertise—only ~6 months at National Instruments versus mandatory 5–10 years on Windows platform
No demonstrated SQL Server or Oracle experience; SQL background appears limited to MySQL and MongoDB web development
No capital markets, fixed-income, derivatives, or investment-banking domain knowledge; fintech experience is in modern web stack, not systems programming
